title: Spanish researchers reduce losses in organic solar cells by restricting emission angle
summary: Spanish researchers have developed an optical cavity that reduces Boltzmann losses in organic solar cells by restricting photon emission angles. The approach could help push single-junction solar cell efficiencies beyond the Shockley-Queisser limit. The post Spanish researchers reduce losses in organic solar cells by restricting emission angle appeared first on pv magazine Global .
